title: OwlSight: A Panoramic Monitor for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments

translated_title: OwlSight：面向思维链推理的全景监测器
translated_abstract: 思维链监测为监督AI系统提供了可操作的证据，有潜力实现早期检测与干预。然而，现有方法专注于特定任务，而对AI（尤其是推理模型）的监管需要监测更广泛的任务范围。我们提出了思维链监测因子这一策略，它支持在提示词中自定义监测需求，使单一监测器能够通过依赖不同因子来覆盖不同任务。此外，我们引入了细粒度和粗粒度两种类型的因子（例如，监测特定电子邮箱地址是否泄露与监测隐私泄露），以满足用户多样化的监测需求。基于此，我们开发了一个名为OwlSight的思维链监测器，它仅依赖因子即可监测涉及能力、安全性和可信度等多个维度的行为。实验
tldr: 提出了基于“因子”的思维链监测策略，通过在提示词中自定义监测需求，使单一监测器能够覆盖能力、安全性和可信度等多个维度的不同任务。
